entities.summary: Ranheim Church is a parish church of the Church of Norway in Trondheim Municipality in Trøndelag county, Norway. It is located in Ranheim, a neighbourhood in the east of Trondheim. It is one of the churches for the Ranheim og Charlottenlund parish which is part of the Strinda prosti (deanery) in the Diocese of Nidaros. The white, stone church was built in a cruciform style using plans drawn up by the architect Roar Tønseth (1895-1985). The church seats about 200 people.
